an4.94:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo lābhī hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya.
an4.94:1.4: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo lābhī hoti adhipaññādhammavipassanāya na lābhī ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa.
an4.94:1.5: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggala na c' eva lābhī hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya.
an4.94:1.6: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo lābhī c' eva hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya. 2.
an4.94:2.1: Tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ puggalo lābhī ajjhattaṃ . . . [93.2] adhipaññādhammavipassanāya tena bhikkhave puggalena yvāyaṃ puggalo lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya so upasaṅkamitvā evam assa
an4.94:2.2: vacanīyo--kathan nu kho āvuso saṅkhārā daṭṭhabbā,
an4.94:2.6: kho āvuso saṅkhārā daṭṭhabbā, evaṃ saṅkhārā sammasitabbā, evaṃ saṅkhārā vipassitabbā ti,
an4.94:2.7: so aparena samayena lābhī c' eva hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya. 3.
an4.94:3.1: Tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ puggalo lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya na lābhī ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa tena bhikkhave puggalena yvāyaṃ puggalo lābhī ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa so upasaṅkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo--
an4.94:3.2: kathan nu kho āvuso cittaṃ saṇṭhapetabbaṃ,
an4.94:3.7: kho āvuso cittaṃ saṇṭhapetabbaṃ, evaṃ cittaṃ sannisādetabbaṃ, evaṃ cittaṃ ekodikattabbaṃ, evaṃ cittaṃ samādahātabban ti,
an4.94:3.8: so aparena samayena lābhī c' eva hoti adhipaññādhammavipassanāya lābhī ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa. 4.
an4.94:4.1: Tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ puggalo na c' eva lābhī ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya tena bhikkhave puggalena yvāyaṃ puggalo lābhī c' eva ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī adhipaññādhammavipasanāya so upasaṅkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo--
an4.94:4.2: kathan nu kho āvuso cittaṃ saṇṭhapetabbaṃ . . .
an4.94:4.10: kho āvuso cittaṃ saṇṭhapetabbaṃ . . . samādahātabbaṃ, evaṃ saṅkhārā daṭṭhabbā . . . vipassitabbā ti,
an4.94:4.11: so aparena samayena lābhī c' eva hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya. 5.
an4.94:5.1: Tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ puggalo lābhī c' eva hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya tena bhikkhave puggalena tesu yeva kusalesu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya uttariṃ āsavānaṃ khayāya yogo karaṇīyo.
an4.94:5.2: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 95. 1.
